name: Mike Arpaia
biography: is a Junior in the CyberSecurity program at Stevens Institute of Technology and is a co-founder of the Stevens Cyber Defense Team. Mike works as a Security Consultant/Penetration Tester Intern at Gotham Digital Science LLC. His primary interests are in web application security and exploitation.
